title: Claude plugin manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json) as generated by this repository
description: Maintained here. Derived from https://claude.com/docs/plugins/build and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (metadata fields verified 2026-10-14; userConfig verified 2026-10-22). Covers only the fields this repository emits; run `claude plugin validate` for the authoritative check.

userConfig.description: Values Claude Code prompts the user for when the plugin is enabled. Keys are identifiers of letters, digits, and underscores that do not start with a digit. Each option is a strict object: an unknown key stops the plugin from loading.

sensitive.description: Masks the input and stores the value in the platform's secure credential store instead of settings.json.
